bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
branch=fix/room-terminal-final-state-priority-20261113
sha=53a31e2047e45a0e61fe9af780a4cfae0b131ef9
w="$r/.worktrees/room-terminal-53a31e2"
tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-terminal-53a31e2
git -C "$r" fetch -q origin "$branch" || exit 70
test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 71
if test -d "$w"; then test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 72; else git -C "$r" worktree add --detach "$w" "$sha" >/dev/null || exit 73; fi
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 75
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 76
test "$(grep -c 'GAYBBS_ROOM_STATUS_EDIT_ENABLED: enabled' "$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml")" = 1 || exit 77
docker compose -p deploy -f "$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" --project-directory "$r/deploy" config -q || exit 78
cd "$w"
docker build --quiet --pull=false --network=host -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t "$tag" . || exit 79
docker image inspect "$tag" --format 'ROOM_TERMINAL_IMAGE_ID={{.Id}}'
echo ROOM_TERMINAL_BUILD_PASS
echo SOURCE_SHA="$sha"
echo USERBOT_AND_PG_UNCHANGED=YES
